units.title: 青龙福到，孟母淑而又慈：财临青龙化子孙、或子孙临青龙动来生助，其妇慈祥恺悌、淑善贤德

rule.yi: 青龙是喜悦慈善的神，子孙又是清吉的神。财爻临青龙化出子孙，或者子孙临青龙、动来生助财爻，这个妇人一定慈祥和乐、贤淑善良，像孟子的母亲。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon is a spirit of joy and kindness, and Output is a clean and lucky spirit. If the Wealth line sits on the Azure Dragon and changes into Output, or Output sits on the Azure Dragon and moves to generate and support it, the woman is surely gentle, kind and virtuous, like Mencius' mother.

zh: 青龙福到，孟母淑而又慈。
yi: 青龙带着福神到来，孟母那样贤淑而又慈爱。
en: The Azure Dragon arriving with Output: virtuous and kind like Mencius' mother.

zh: 青龙乃喜悦慈善之神，子孙又清吉之神。
若财临青龙，化子，或子临青龙动来生助者，必主其妇慈祥恺悌，淑善贤德。
如孟母也。
yi: 青龙是喜悦慈善的神，子孙又是清吉的神。
如果财爻临青龙、化出子孙，或者子孙临青龙、动来生助，一定主这个妇人慈祥和乐、淑善贤德。
就像孟母。
en: The Azure Dragon is a spirit of joy and kindness, and Output is a clean and lucky spirit.
If the Wealth line sits on the Azure Dragon and changes into Output, or Output sits on the Azure Dragon and moves to generate and support it, the woman is surely gentle, kind, good and virtuous.
Like Mencius' mother.

zh: 青龙主仁慈，子孙主清正，若财临青龙化子，或子临青龙生财，其妇自慈祥恺悌，贤德如孟母也。
yi: 青龙主仁慈，子孙主清正，如果财爻临青龙化子孙，或者子孙临青龙生财，这个妇人自然慈祥和乐，贤德像孟母。
en: The Azure Dragon stands for benevolence and Output for uprightness; if the Wealth line sits on the Azure Dragon and changes into Output, or Output sits on the Azure Dragon and generates Wealth, the woman is naturally gentle and kind, her virtue like Mencius' mother's.

units.title: 逢龙而化败兄，蔡琰聪明而失节：财遇青龙本主聪明，但不宜化出兄爻及败爻，皆主不贞洁；化出刑爻、病爻、害爻及玄武同临亦然

rule.yi: 财爻遇到青龙，本来主聪明，但是不宜化出兄弟爻，也不宜化出败爻（沐浴之类），那样都主不贞洁，还兼不长寿。化出刑爻、病爻、害爻，以及玄武同临的，也是这样。像蔡琰，文章冠绝一时，却在胡人那里失了节。
rule.en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means cleverness in itself, but it should not change out into a Peer line or into a ruined stage such as the Bath; either means she is not chaste, and short-lived besides. The same for changing out into a punishing, sick or harming line, and for the Dark Tortoise sitting with it. Like Cai Yan, whose writing surpassed all others of her time and who lost her chastity among the barbarians.

zh: 逢龙而化败兄，汉蔡琰聪明而失节；
yi: 遇到青龙，而又化出败落的兄弟爻，像汉朝的蔡琰，聪明却失了节。
en: Meeting the Azure Dragon yet changing into a ruined Peer line: like Cai Yan of Han, clever but losing her chastity;

zh: 财遇青龙，本主聪明。
但不宜化出兄爻，及败爻。
皆主不贞洁。
如伯喈女蔡琰，文章绝冠当时，失节胡虏。
或化出刑爻病爻害爻，及玄武等同临者亦然。
yi: 财爻遇到青龙，本来主聪明。
但是不宜化出兄弟爻，以及败爻。
那样都主不贞洁。
就像蔡邕的女儿蔡琰，文章冠绝当时，却在胡人那里失了节。
或者化出刑爻、病爻、害爻，以及玄武等同时临在上面的，也是这样。
en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means cleverness in itself.
But it should not change out into a Peer line or into a ruined line.
Either way she is not chaste.
Like Cai Yan, Cai Yong's daughter, whose writing surpassed all others of her time and who lost her chastity among the barbarians.
The same if it changes out into a punishing, sick or harming line, or if the Dark Tortoise and the like sit on it as well.

zh: 财遇青龙本主聪明，如化兄弟及沐浴，皆主不贞洁兼不寿，如蔡琰文章绝世，失节胡人。
yi: 财爻遇到青龙，本来主聪明，如果化出兄弟爻以及沐浴，都主不贞洁，还兼不长寿，像蔡琰文章绝世，却在胡人那里失了节。
en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means cleverness in itself, but if it changes out into a Peer line or the Bath stage, she is not chaste and short-lived besides, like Cai Yan, whose writing was without equal and who lost her chastity among the barbarians.

note.yi: 「败」指十二长生里衰败的几位，卜筮正宗举的是沐浴。蔡琰（文姬）是蔡邕的女儿，被匈奴掳去，嫁给匈奴左贤王，后来被曹操赎回。
note.en: 'Ruined' means the falling stages of the twelve life stages, of which the Zhengzong names the Bath. Cai Yan (Wenji) was the daughter of Cai Yong; she was carried off by the Xiongnu and married to a Xiongnu prince, and was later ransomed by Cao Cao.

units.title: 化子而生身世，鲁伯姬贤德无疵：财动化出子孙、生合世身，必有懿德；占妇人身命以财爻为主，不以应世作其身

rule.yi: 财爻动、化出子孙，生合世爻和卦身的，这个妇人一定有美德，言行都好，没有可挑剔的，像鲁国的伯姬。凡是占（妇人）的身命，要以财爻为主，不能拿应爻、世爻当作她本人。
rule.en: If the Wealth line moves, changes out into Output and generates or combines with the Self line and the Body, the woman surely has fine virtue, good in word and deed and beyond reproach, like Bo Ji of Lu. In divining a (woman's) person, take the Wealth line as the main sign; the Other and Self lines are not to be taken as the person.

zh: 化子而生身世，鲁伯姬贤德无疵。
yi: 化出子孙来生扶世爻和卦身，鲁国的伯姬那样贤德没有瑕疵。
en: Changing into Output that generates the Self and Body: virtue like Bo Ji of Lu, without a flaw.

zh: 财动化出子孙，生合世身者，必有懿德。
如鲁庄公夫人伯姬，言行皆善，无疵可议，见赏于春秋。
yi: 财爻动、化出子孙，生合世爻和卦身的，一定有美德。
就像鲁庄公的夫人伯姬，言行都好，没有可以挑剔议论的，在《春秋》里受到称赞。
en: If the Wealth line moves, changes out into Output and generates or combines with the Self line and the Body, she surely has fine virtue.
Like Bo Ji, wife of Duke Zhuang of Lu, good in word and deed and beyond criticism, who was praised in the Spring and Autumn Annals.

zh: 凡占身，当以财爻为主，不可论应爻世爻等作其身也。
yi: 凡是占（妇人的）身命，应当以财爻为主，不可以拿应爻、世爻等当作她本人。
en: In divining a (woman's) person, the Wealth line should be the main sign; the Other and Self lines and the like are not to be taken as the person.

zh: 财动化出子孙生合世身者，必有懿德，如鲁庄公夫人伯姬，言行皆善，无可议之也。
yi: 财爻动、化出子孙，生合世爻和卦身的，一定有美德，像鲁庄公夫人伯姬，言行都好，没有可以议论的。
en: If the Wealth line moves, changes out into Output and generates or combines with the Self line and the Body, she surely has fine virtue, like Bo Ji, wife of Duke Zhuang of Lu, good in word and deed and beyond discussion.

note.yi: 鲁国的伯姬是鲁宣公的女儿、嫁给宋共公，《春秋》记她宋国宫中失火时守礼不肯夜出，被烧死；书里说她是「鲁庄公夫人」，与史书不合，译文照书。
note.en: Bo Ji of Lu was a daughter of Duke Xuan of Lu, married to Duke Gong of Song; the Spring and Autumn Annals record that when fire broke out in the Song palace she kept to propriety and would not leave in the night, and was burned to death. The book calls her the wife of Duke Zhuang of Lu, which does not agree with the histories, and the translation follows the book.

units.title: 合而遇空，窦二女不辱于盗贼：他爻动来合、或咸池玄武动来克合，若财爻落空避之，是彼欲淫我而我不愿，宁死不受辱

rule.yi: 卦中如果有别的爻动来相合，或者咸池、玄武动来克合，本不是好兆头；要是财爻落在空亡里避开了，就是对方想污辱我而我不愿意的样子，像唐朝奉天的窦氏两个女儿，被强盗劫住，跳崖也不肯受辱。
rule.en: If another line moves to combine with it in the hexagram, or the Xianchi star or the Dark Tortoise moves to control the combination, it is not a good sign in itself; but if the Wealth line falls into Void and avoids it, it is the picture of the other wanting to defile me and my being unwilling, like the two daughters of the Dou family at Fengtian in Tang, seized by bandits, who leapt off a cliff rather than be shamed.

zh: 合而遇空，窦二女不辱于盗贼；
yi: 合了又遇到空，窦家两个女儿没有被盗贼污辱；
en: Combination meeting Void: the two Dou daughters were not shamed by the bandits;

zh: 卦中若遇他爻动来相合，或带咸池玄武动来克合，本非佳兆。
若得财爻在空避之，是彼欲淫我，而我不愿之象。
如唐奉天窦氏二女，被盗劫之，而自投崖，宁死不受辱也。
yi: 卦中如果遇到别的爻动来相合，或者带着咸池、玄武动来克合，本不是好兆头。
要是财爻落在空里避开了，就是他想污辱我、而我不愿意的样子。
就像唐朝奉天窦氏两个女儿，被盗贼劫住，自己跳下悬崖，宁死也不受辱。
en: If in the hexagram another line moves to combine with it, or moves carrying the Xianchi star or the Dark Tortoise to control the combination, it is not a good sign in itself.
If the Wealth line falls into Void and avoids it, it is the picture of him wanting to defile me and my being unwilling.
Like the two Dou daughters at Fengtian in Tang, seized by bandits, who threw themselves off a cliff and would die rather than be shamed.

zh: 若他爻动来相合，或玄武咸池动来克合，若财爻值空，如唐奉天窦氏二女被盗劫，投崖宁死不受辱也。
yi: 如果别的爻动来相合，或者玄武、咸池动来克合，财爻又落在空亡，就像唐朝奉天窦氏两个女儿被盗贼劫住，跳崖宁死不受辱。
en: If another line moves to combine with it, or the Dark Tortoise or the Xianchi star moves to control the combination, and the Wealth line falls into Void, it is like the two Dou daughters at Fengtian in Tang, seized by bandits, who leapt off a cliff and would die rather than be shamed.

units.title: 静而冲动，卓文君投奔于相如：咸池玄武刑害等杀临持财爻，休囚不动或落空亡则无事，被日辰动爻冲动则夜奔

rule.yi: 卦中咸池、玄武、刑害这类煞星临持在财爻上，如果休囚不动，或者落在空亡，大概没事；要是被日辰、动爻冲动，就像卓文君被司马相如用琴挑动，心动了，免不了夜里私奔相如，后来当垆卖酒。
rule.en: If ill stars such as the Xianchi star, the Dark Tortoise, punishment and harm sit on the Wealth line, then if it is resting and still or falls into Void it is probably safe; but if the Day or a moving line clashes and stirs it, she is like Zhuo Wenjun, whom Sima Xiangru stirred with the zither: her heart moves, and she cannot but elope to Xiangru by night, and later sell wine at the counter.

zh: 静而冲动，卓文君投奔于相如。
yi: 静着的爻被冲动，卓文君投奔了司马相如。
en: A still line clashed into motion: Zhuo Wenjun ran off to Xiangru.

zh: 卦中咸池玄武刑害等杀，临持财爻，若得休囚不动，或落空亡，庶几无事。
若被日辰动爻冲之，则如卓文君，被相如以琴挑之，欲心因动，不免至夜而亡奔相如，后当垆卖酒。
yi: 卦中咸池、玄武、刑害这类煞，临持在财爻上，如果得到休囚不动，或者落在空亡，大概没事。
如果被日辰、动爻冲它，就像卓文君被相如用琴挑动，欲心动了，免不了夜里逃出去投奔相如，后来当垆卖酒。
en: If ill stars such as the Xianchi star, the Dark Tortoise, punishment and harm sit on the Wealth line, then if it is resting and still or falls into Void it is probably safe.

If the Day or a moving line clashes it, she is like Zhuo Wenjun, whom Xiangru stirred with the zither: her desire moves, and she cannot but flee to Xiangru by night, and later sell wine at the counter.

zh: 咸池玄武持财，若衰空不动者无碍，若日辰动爻冲之，如相如以琴挑动，卓文君夜奔相如，后当炉卖酒。
yi: 咸池、玄武临持在财爻上，如果衰空不动的没有妨碍，如果被日辰、动爻冲它，就像相如用琴挑动，卓文君夜里私奔相如，后来当垆卖酒。
en: If the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise sit on the Wealth line, then if it is weak, void and still there is no harm, but if the Day or a moving line clashes it, it is like Xiangru stirring her with the zither, and Zhuo Wenjun eloped to Xiangru by night and later sold wine at the counter.

note.yi: 卓文君是卓王孙的女儿，新寡，听司马相如弹琴，夜里私奔与他成亲，后来在临邛开酒店，自己站柜卖酒。
note.en: Zhuo Wenjun was Zhuo Wangsun's daughter, newly widowed; hearing Sima Xiangru play the zither she eloped with him by night and married him, and later they kept a wine shop at Linqiong where she herself stood at the counter.

units.title: 福引刑爻发动，卫共姜作誓于柏舟：子孙带刑旺动必克夫；但子孙是贞洁之神，财不值凶者主守节

rule.yi: 子孙带刑、旺相发动，一定克丈夫；但子孙是贞洁的神，遇到这样的爻而财爻不逢凶的，主守节（守寡不改嫁），像卫国的共姜作《柏舟》诗，以死自誓。
rule.en: Output carrying punishment and moving on strength surely harms the husband; but Output is a spirit of chastity, and if with such a line the Wealth line does not meet ill, it means keeping faith (a widow not remarrying), like Gong Jiang of Wei, who wrote the poem 'Cypress Boat' and swore by death.

zh: 福引刑爻发动，卫共姜作誓于柏舟；
yi: 子孙引着刑爻发动，卫国的共姜写了《柏舟》诗立誓；
en: Output leading a punishing line to move: Gong Jiang of Wei swore her vow in 'Cypress Boat';

zh: 子带刑旺动，必主克夫。
然子乃贞洁之神，遇此等爻，而财不值凶者，主守节之象。
如卫共姜，作柏舟诗，以死自誓也。
yi: 子孙带着刑、旺相发动，一定克丈夫。
但子孙是贞洁的神，遇到这样的爻，而财爻不逢凶的，主守节的样子。
就像卫共姜，作《柏舟》诗，以死自誓。
en: Output carrying punishment, strong and moving, surely harms the husband.
But Output is a spirit of chastity, and with such a line, if the Wealth line does not meet ill, it means keeping faith.
Like Gong Jiang of Wei, who wrote the poem 'Cypress Boat' and swore by death.

zh: 子孙旺动主克夫，然子乃贞洁之神，主守节之象，如卫共姜作柏舟诗，以死自誓也。
yi: 子孙旺相发动，主克夫，但是子孙是贞洁的神，主守节的样子，就像卫共姜作《柏舟》诗，以死自誓。
en: Output strong and moving means harm to the husband, but Output is a spirit of chastity and means keeping faith, like Gong Jiang of Wei, who wrote the poem 'Cypress Boat' and swore by death.

note.yi: 《诗经·鄘风·柏舟》据《毛诗序》是卫世子共伯的妻子共姜在丈夫早死后、拒绝父母要她改嫁而作。「福」指子孙爻。
note.en: According to the Mao Preface, the 'Cypress Boat' of the Odes (Yong Feng) was written by Gong Jiang, wife of the Wei crown prince Gong Bo, after her husband's early death, when she refused her parents' wish that she marry again. 'Fortune' here means the Output line.

units.title: 身遭化鬼克刑，班婕妤感伤乎秋扇：卦中官与身世相生合，又化官来克制身世及财爻，先亲爱后弃绝

rule.yi: 卦里本来有官鬼，和世爻、卦身相生相合，又化出官鬼来克制世爻、卦身和财爻。断法是动爻为开始，变爻为结局，主先亲爱、后疏绝，像汉朝的班婕妤对汉武帝，起初宠爱，后来疏远；所以看到秋天的扇子而感伤作词，寄托她凄楚的心情。
rule.en: If the hexagram has Pressure from the start, generating and combining with the Self line and the Body, and then changes into Pressure that controls the Self, the Body and the Wealth line, then, since the moving line is the start and the changed line the end, it shows close affection first and rejection after, like Ban Jieyu of Han and the emperor, favored at first and later cast off; hence she wrote a poem in sorrow at seeing the autumn fan, giving voice to her bitter feelings.

zh: 身遭化鬼克刑，班婕妤感伤乎秋扇。
yi: 卦身遭遇化出官鬼来克制刑伤，班婕妤看着秋天的扇子感伤；
en: The Body meeting a change into Pressure that controls and punishes it: Ban Jieyu grieved at the autumn fan;

zh: 卦中原有官，与身世相生合，又化官，却来克制身世，及财爻。
占法以动爻为始，变爻为终。
主先亲爱，后弃绝之象。
如汉班婕妤于武帝，始亲爱，后疏绝。
所以，见秋扇而感伤作词，以寓其凄楚之思。
yi: 卦中原来有官鬼，和世爻、卦身相生相合，后来又化出官鬼，反过来克制世爻、卦身，以及财爻。
占法是以动爻为开始，变爻为结局。
主先亲爱、后弃绝的样子。
就像汉朝班婕妤对汉武帝，起初亲爱，后来疏远断绝。
所以看见秋天的扇子而感伤作词，寄托她凄楚的心情。
en: The hexagram had Pressure at first, generating and combining with the Self line and the Body, and then it changes into Pressure that in turn controls the Self line, the Body and the Wealth line.
The method is to take the moving line as the start and the changed line as the end.
It shows close affection first and rejection after.
Like Ban Jieyu of Han with the emperor Wu, close at first and later estranged and cut off.
So seeing the autumn fan she grieved and wrote a poem, giving voice to her bitter feelings.

zh: 如卦象六合而世爻化官鬼刑克，以动爻为始，以变爻为终，如汉班姬于成帝始亲爱后疏远，所以见秋扇而感伤，作词以寓其凄楚之意。
yi: 比如卦象六合，而世爻化出官鬼刑克，以动爻为开始，以变爻为结局，像汉朝班婕妤对汉成帝，起初亲爱、后来疏远，所以看见秋天的扇子感伤，作词寄托她凄楚的心意。
en: For example a hexagram of Six-combine in which the Self line changes into a punishing, controlling Pressure line: taking the moving line as the start and the changed line as the end, it is like Ban Jieyu of Han with the emperor Cheng, close at first and later estranged, so that seeing the autumn fan she grieved and wrote a poem giving voice to her bitter feelings.

note.yi: 班婕妤是汉成帝的妃子，失宠后作《怨歌行》，以秋天被收起的团扇自比。卜筮大全说「汉武帝」，卜筮正宗说「汉成帝」，史实是成帝；译文各照原书。
note.en: Ban Jieyu was a consort of Emperor Cheng of Han; after losing favor she wrote the 'Song of Resentment', likening herself to a round fan put away in autumn. The Quanshu says 'Emperor Wu of Han' and the Zhengzong 'Emperor Cheng of Han'; the emperor in history is Cheng, and each translation follows its own book.

units.title: 二鬼争权水父冲，钱玉莲逢汝权于江浒：二鬼发动都来生合财爻，又遇水父来冲，财爻落空避之，主两夫争权、父母逼勒，而己有守节之操

rule.yi: 卦里如果有两个官鬼都发动，都来生合财爻，又遇到属水的父母爻来刑冲克害，财爻落在空亡里避开的，一定是两个男人争夺她、父母逼迫她的样子；而她自己有守节的节操，所以躲进空亡。像孙汝权对钱玉莲。
rule.en: If two Pressure lines in the hexagram both move and both generate and combine with the Wealth line, and a Resource line of Water comes to punish, clash and control it, with the Wealth line falling into Void to avoid it, it is the picture of two men contending for her and her parents forcing her; she herself holds to her chastity and so hides in Void. Like Sun Ruquan and Qian Yulian.

zh: 二鬼争权水父冲，钱玉莲逢汝权于江浒；
yi: 两个官鬼争权，又遇到属水的父母爻来冲，钱玉莲在江边遇到了孙汝权；
en: Two Pressure lines contending, and a Water Resource line clashing: Qian Yulian met Sun Ruquan at the river's edge;

zh: 卦中若有二鬼发动，俱来生合财爻，又遇水父来刑冲克害，而财爻在空避之者，必有两夫争权之象，父母逼勒之兆。
而己有守节之操，故入于空。
如孙汝权之于玉莲类也。
yi: 卦中如果有两个官鬼发动，都来生合财爻，又遇到属水的父母爻来刑冲克害，而财爻落在空里避开的，一定有两个丈夫争权的样子、父母逼迫的征兆。
而她自己有守节的操守，所以落入空亡。
就像孙汝权对钱玉莲这一类。
en: If two Pressure lines in the hexagram move and both generate and combine with the Wealth line, and a Water Resource line comes to punish, clash and control it, with the Wealth line falling into Void to avoid it, there is surely the picture of two husbands contending and the sign of her parents forcing her.
She herself holds to her chastity, and so it falls into Void.
Like Sun Ruquan and Qian Yulian.

zh: 若有二鬼发动，俱来生合财爻，又遇水父来冲，而财爻值空者，必有两夫争权之象，父母逼勒之兆，自有守节之操，故入于空，如孙汝权之于钱玉莲类也。
yi: 如果有两个官鬼发动，都来生合财爻，又遇到属水的父母爻来冲，而财爻落在空亡的，一定有两个丈夫争权的样子、父母逼迫的征兆，她自己有守节的操守，所以落入空亡，像孙汝权对钱玉莲这一类。
en: If two Pressure lines move and both generate and combine with the Wealth line, and a Water Resource line comes to clash it, with the Wealth line falling into Void, there is surely the picture of two husbands contending and the sign of her parents forcing her; she herself holds to her chastity and so it falls into Void, like Sun Ruquan and Qian Yulian.

note.yi: 钱玉莲、孙汝权出自《荆钗记》：钱玉莲嫁王十朋，孙汝权是想夺她的富家子，后来她被逼改嫁、投江。这里只用它说两男争一女、女子守节的情形。
note.en: Qian Yulian and Sun Ruquan are from the play Jingchai Ji: Qian Yulian married Wang Shipeng, and Sun Ruquan was the rich young man who wanted to take her; she was later pressed to marry again and threw herself into the river. It is used here only for two men contending over one woman and the woman keeping faith.

units.title: 六爻竞合阴财动，秦弱兰遇陶谷于邮亭：男带合聪明俊秀，女带合浇浮淫佚；六合卦而财爻属阴，不动犹可，动则淫滥无耻

rule.yi: 男子卦带合，聪明俊秀；女子卦带合，轻浮淫乱。要是六合卦而财爻又属阴，不动还算可以，一动就淫滥无耻，像秦弱兰在驿亭遇到陶学士。（卜筮正宗补充：财爻和世爻相合的，不能这样断；女人自己占卦，世爻就是她自己，发动去合别的爻也这样断。）
rule.en: A man's hexagram with combination is clever and handsome; a woman's with combination is frivolous and lewd. If the hexagram is a Six-combine and the Wealth line is yin, then still it is passable, but moving it is dissolute and shameless, like Qin Ruolan meeting Scholar Tao at the post pavilion. (The Zhengzong adds: where the Wealth line combines with the Self line one must not judge so; when a woman divines for herself the Self line is herself, and moving to combine with another line is judged the same.)

zh: 六爻竞合阴财动，秦弱兰遇陶谷于邮亭。
yi: 六爻都在竞相相合、阴的财爻发动，秦弱兰在邮亭遇到了陶谷。
en: All six lines vying to combine and a yin Wealth line moving: Qin Ruolan met Tao Gu at the post pavilion.

zh: 男带合，则俊秀聪明；
女带合，则浇浮淫佚。
若六合卦而财爻又属阴者，不动犹可，动则淫滥无耻。
如秦弱兰遇陶学士也。
yi: 男子带合，就聪明俊秀；
女子带合，就轻浮淫乱。
如果是六合卦，而财爻又属阴的，不动还可以，一动就淫滥无耻。
就像秦弱兰遇到陶学士。
en: A man with combination is clever and handsome;
a woman with combination is frivolous and lewd.
If it is a Six-combine hexagram and the Wealth line is yin, then still it is passable, but moving it is dissolute and shameless.
Like Qin Ruolan meeting Scholar Tao.

zh: 男带合则俊秀聪明，女带合则娇浮淫逸。
若六合卦而财爻又属阴者，不动尤可，动则淫滥无耻，如秦弱兰遇陶学士也。
如财爻与世相合，不可此断。
如女人自卜，以世为自己，发动合旁爻亦此断。
yi: 男子带合就聪明俊秀，女子带合就娇媚轻浮淫逸。
如果是六合卦而财爻又属阴的，不动还可以，动了就淫滥无耻，像秦弱兰遇到陶学士。
如果财爻和世爻相合，不能这样断。
如果是女人自己占卦，以世爻为自己，发动去合别的爻，也这样断。
en: A man with combination is clever and handsome; a woman with combination is coquettish, frivolous and lewd.
If it is a Six-combine hexagram and the Wealth line is yin, then still it is passable, but moving it is dissolute and shameless, like Qin Ruolan meeting Scholar Tao.
If the Wealth line combines with the Self line, one must not judge so.
If a woman divines for herself, the Self line is herself, and moving to combine with another line is judged the same way.

note.yi: 陶谷是宋初出使南唐的使臣，自命端方，南唐派官妓秦弱兰扮作驿卒之女，在驿亭里勾住了他。「邮亭」就是驿亭。
note.en: Tao Gu was an envoy of early Song to the Southern Tang who prided himself on his uprightness; the Southern Tang sent the courtesan Qin Ruolan, disguised as a courier's daughter, and she caught him at the post pavilion. 'Youting' is the post pavilion.

units.title: 鬼弱而未获生扶，朱淑贞良人愚蠢：女人身命以鬼为夫星，不宜空亡、不宜动、不宜衰弱；衰弱无生扶又带勾陈螣蛇，夫愚蒙不正

rule.yi: 看女人的身命，以官鬼为夫星。夫星不宜空亡，空亡就难做丈夫；又不宜发动，发动就为难兄弟（克伤兄弟爻）；也不宜衰弱，弱就招来不成器的丈夫、发不了福。要是衰弱又得不到一点生扶合助，还带勾陈、螣蛇这些凶神，一定像朱淑真的丈夫，愚昧不正、人又矮小，所以她才有断肠的诗。
rule.en: In reading a woman's person, Pressure is the husband star. It should not be Void, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband; it should not move, for moving is hard on the brothers (Pressure controls the Peer line); and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband who cannot bring fortune. If it is weak with no support or help at all and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill spirit, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, and that is why she wrote her heartbroken poems.

zh: 鬼弱而未获生扶，朱淑贞良人愚蠢；
yi: 官鬼弱而没有得到生扶，朱淑贞的丈夫愚蠢；
en: Pressure weak and without support: Zhu Shuzhen's husband was stupid;

zh: 凡看女人身命，以鬼为夫星。
不宜空亡，空亡则难为夫主；
又不宜动，动则难为兄弟；
亦不宜衰弱，弱则招夫不肖，不能发福。
若衰弱而无一生扶合助，兼带勾陈螣蛇等凶神者，必如朱淑真之夫，愚蒙不正，人物侏儒，因有断肠之诗。
yi: 凡是看女人的身命，以官鬼为夫星。
不宜空亡，空亡就难做丈夫；
又不宜发动，发动就为难兄弟；
也不宜衰弱，衰弱就招来不成器的丈夫，发不了福。
如果衰弱又没有一点生扶合助，还带着勾陈、螣蛇这些凶神，一定像朱淑真的丈夫，愚昧不正，人又矮小，所以她有断肠的诗。
en: In every reading of a woman's person, Pressure is the husband star.
It should not be Void, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband;
it should not move, for moving is hard on the brothers (it controls the Peer line);
and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband who cannot bring fortune.

If it is weak with no support or help at all and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill spirit, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, which is why she has her heartbroken poems.

zh: 凡女人身命，以鬼为夫星，不宜旬空，空则难为夫主；
又不宜弱，弱则招夫不肖。
若衰弱而无生扶合助，兼带勾陈螣蛇等煞者，必如朱淑贞之夫，愚蒙不正，人物侏儒，因有断肠之时。
yi: 凡是女人的身命，以官鬼为夫星，不宜旬空，空就难做丈夫；
又不宜衰弱，衰弱就招来不成器的丈夫。
如果衰弱又没有生扶合助，还带着勾陈、螣蛇这些煞，一定像朱淑贞的丈夫，愚昧不正，人又矮小，所以有断肠的时候。
en: In every woman's reading of her person, Pressure is the husband star; it should not be in a void ten-day cycle, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband;
and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband.

If it is weak with no support or help and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill star, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, hence the time of a broken heart.

note.yi: 朱淑真是南宋女词人，嫁给不相称的丈夫，郁郁而终，诗集叫《断肠集》。卜筮大全作「朱淑贞」「侏儒」。「动则难为兄弟」按官鬼克兄弟爻来读（官鬼发动伤克兄弟，见 LY.MARRY.DYTJ.11）。这一条是「女占夫」的一般规则，和婚姻章里女占男的说法可以合着读（LY.MARRY.HJC.22）。
note.en: Zhu Shuzhen was a Southern Song woman poet married to an ill-matched husband who died unhappy; her collection is called 'Heartbroken Poems'. The Quanshu writes 'Zhu Shuzhen' and 'dwarf'. 'Moving makes it hard on the brothers' is read as Pressure controlling the Peer line (a moving Pressure line injures the Peer line, LY.MARRY.DYTJ.11). This is the general rule for a woman divining about a husband and can be read together with what the marriage chapter says of a woman divining about a man (LY.MARRY.HJC.22).

units.title: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明：鬼爻旺相更逢青龙福德、禄马贵人，主有贵显贤明之夫；衰而逢助亦有贤明之夫

rule.yi: 官鬼爻旺相，又碰上青龙、福德、禄马、贵人这些吉神，一定有显贵贤明的丈夫，像吴孟子嫁给鲁昭公；官鬼衰弱但得到生扶，也有贤明的丈夫。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is strong and also meets lucky spirits such as the Azure Dragon, Output, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she surely has an eminent, wise husband, like Wu Mengzi who married Duke Zhao of Lu; if Pressure is weak but supported, she also has a wise husband.

zh: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明。
yi: 官鬼强而又连着青龙、福德，吴孟子的丈夫贤明。
en: Pressure strong and joined to the Azure Dragon and Output: Wu Mengzi's husband was wise.

zh: 若鬼爻旺相，更逢青龙福德、禄马贵人等吉神，必主有贵显贤明之夫。
如吴孟子得鲁昭公为夫也。
若衰而逢助，亦主有贤明之夫。
yi: 如果官鬼爻旺相，又碰上青龙、福德、禄马、贵人这些吉神，一定主有显贵贤明的丈夫。
就像吴孟子得到鲁昭公做丈夫。
如果衰弱但得到生扶，也主有贤明的丈夫。
en: If the Pressure line is strong and also meets lucky spirits such as the Azure Dragon, Output, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she surely has an eminent and wise husband.
Like Wu Mengzi, who had Duke Zhao of Lu for a husband.
If it is weak but meets support, she also has a wise husband.

zh: 若鬼爻临量，遇青龙、禄马、贵人，主有贵显贤明之夫，如吴孟子得鲁昭公为夫也。
若衰弱而逢生助亦然。
yi: 如果官鬼爻强，遇到青龙、禄马、贵人，主有显贵贤明的丈夫，像吴孟子得到鲁昭公做丈夫。
如果衰弱但得到生扶，也是这样。
en: If the Pressure line is strong and meets the Azure Dragon, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she has an eminent and wise husband, like Wu Mengzi, who had Duke Zhao of Lu for a husband.
The same if it is weak but meets support.

note.yi: 吴孟子是鲁昭公的夫人，吴国人，姓姬，因同姓不婚才不称「吴姬」而称「孟子」。卜筮正宗的「临量」疑是「临旺」之误，译文按「强」并照旺相解。
note.en: Wu Mengzi was the wife of Duke Zhao of Lu, from the state of Wu; she was of the Ji surname, and because marriage within a surname was avoided she was called 'Mengzi' and not 'Wu Ji'. The Zhengzong's 'lin liang' looks like a slip for 'lin wang' (sitting on strength), and is taken as 'strong'.

units.title: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈：占身以福为子、财为妻，二爻临死墓绝空之地是刑妻丧子之兆，小儿见之出家，僧道见之反吉

rule.yi: 占身命，子孙爻是儿子，财爻是妻子。这两个爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，是刑妻丧子的征兆。小孩子见到这种卦，一定超脱世俗、出家；僧人道士见到反而是吉兆，没有世俗的牵累。
rule.en: In divining one's person, the Output line is the son and the Wealth line the wife. If these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife punished and a son lost. A child meeting this will surely leave the world and become a monk or nun; a monk or Taoist meeting it finds it lucky, with no worldly ties to hold him.

zh: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈；
yi: 子孙死了、妻财落空，是绝俗离尘的人；
en: Output dead and Wealth void: one who cuts off worldly ties;

zh: 占身以福为子，财为妻。
二爻若临死墓绝空之地，乃是刑妻丧子之兆。
小儿见之，必绝俗离尘，出家辈也。
若僧道见之，反为吉兆，必无俗累之牵惹矣。
yi: 占身命，以福德爻为儿子，以财爻为妻子。
这两爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，就是刑妻丧子的征兆。
小孩子见到，一定超脱世俗、出家的人。
如果是僧人道士见到，反而是吉兆，一定没有世俗的牵累。
en: In divining one's person, take the Output line as the son and the Wealth line as the wife.
If these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife punished and a son lost.
A child meeting this will surely be one who leaves the world and becomes a monk or nun.
If a monk or Taoist meets it, on the contrary it is lucky, and surely he has no worldly ties to hold him.

zh: 以福为子，财为妻，二爻若临死墓绝空之地，乃是刑丧妻子之兆，必绝俗离尘辈也。
yi: 以福德爻为儿子，财爻为妻子，这两爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，是刑伤妻子、丧失儿子的征兆，一定是超脱世俗的人。
en: Take the Output line as the son and the Wealth line as the wife; if these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife injured and a son lost, and he is surely one who leaves the world.

note.yi: 这一条是「占身命」里说的，不是专门占婚姻；收在这里是因为「刑妻」是婚姻的后果之一。卜筮大全在同一首赋的另一处（第 9617 行）重复了这一句。
note.en: This entry is said of divining one's person and not specially of marriage; it is included because a wife punished is one of the consequences of a marriage. The Quanshu repeats the line in another place in the same rhapsody (line 9617).
